title: Alliance Medical Ministry and Incredable Partner to Enhance Patient Care Through Simplified Credentialing
text:
Alliance Medical Ministry has transformed its credentialing process by partnering with Incredable—eliminating inefficiencies, improving compliance, and freeing up valuable staff time to focus on patient care.
(PRUnderground) April 16th, 2025
Alliance Medical Ministry, a nonprofit providing primary care services to uninsured individuals in Wake County, NC, has partnered with Incredable to improve its credentialing process. By adopting Incredable’s credentialing management platform, the organization has enhanced efficiency, organization, and compliance, allowing its team to focus more on delivering high-quality patient care.
The Alliance Medical Ministry partnership is the latest milestone in a period of rapid growth for Incredable. Following recent partnerships with Tri-State Community Healthcare and Remedy, as well as the launch of its highly customizable Dynamic Profiles feature, Incredable continues to demonstrate its ability to serve a wide range of healthcare organizations, from small nonprofit clinics to multi-site networks.
Before adopting Incredable, Alliance Medical Ministry lacked a centralized system for managing provider credentials, making it challenging to track essential documents and ensure compliance. “Before we started using Incredable, our credentialing process was all over the place,” said Dr. Edwin Burkett, Medical Director at Alliance Medical Ministry. “We were relying on spreadsheets, word of mouth, and unsecured files. It was difficult to ensure everything was in order. Incredable gave us one place to keep everything secure and organized.”
With Incredable, Alliance Medical Ministry now has a single, secure platform to manage provider credentials. One of the most impactful features has been the ability to track document expirations, ensuring the team easily stays ahead of renewals. “The ability to track when licenses are about to expire is one of our most important features,” Dr. Burkett explained. “It helps us stay on top of everything and ensures that we’re compliant without digging through old records. It’s a huge time-saver and provides peace of mind.”
Beyond the platform’s capabilities, the implementation process was smooth, with a user-friendly interface that required minimal training. “When we first started, Incredable’s team walked us through the process. It was very intuitive, and we were able to get up and running quickly. The training sessions were incredibly helpful, and when we had questions, the support team was always there to help,” said Dr. Burkett. “Even though we’re a small clinic, we’ve always felt like we’re a priority.”
With the credentialing process now streamlined, Alliance Medical Ministry has shifted its focus from administrative tasks to patient care. The time saved has allowed staff to take on new responsibilities, increasing workflow efficiency. “Using Incredable has freed up time for our small team. It’s not just about saving time, but about the peace of mind that everything is in one place and correct,” said Dr. Burkett. “Now, instead of me having to manage credentials, I have our volunteer coordinator and medical assistant handling it regularly. It’s been a huge improvement in terms of quality and consistency.”
Dr. Burkett sees Incredable as a game-changer for clinics facing similar credentialing challenges. “I’ve spoken with other medical directors of charitable and safety-net clinics, and I’ve already recommended Incredable to them. I know it can really help smaller clinics like ours. It’s a simple, effective solution that works.”
